model.summary: Model favors LA by 6.9 points (72% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (LA +4.1), Scoring margin (last 8 games) (LA +2.4), Offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (ARI +1.7). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 45.9 total points (ARI 20, LA 26). Biggest factors: Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.9), Divisional game (lowers total 0.8), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
